historical_exposure: official test already observed in Stage5; excluded from these heads fitting/calibration but not pristine project confirmation

rules.comparison: strict score > each previously frozen normal-only calibration threshold
rules.confidence_screen: primary recall lower bound >= .95 AND FPR upper bound < .10; descriptive on this historically observed benchmark
rules.failure_policy: abort on integrity error, incomplete scores, or model/source mutation; preserve failures; no tuning until pass
rules.fit_diagnostic: score each models existing 420 fitting images using existing cache; descriptive only
rules.independence: physical product/production lot identifiers unavailable; appearance auditing cannot prove independence
rules.point_target: recall >= 0.95 AND normal false-positive rate < 0.10 AND complete coverage
rules.replay: fresh process, reverse image order, all 1004 images and all four checkpoints; exact score/decision comparison
rules.score: valid-ROI mean of the top ceil(0.001*N) segmentation logits
rules.secondary_seeds: all three fixed corrected seeds reported; never replace primary using test scores
rules.uncertainty: Clopper-Pearson 95% two-sided intervals; simultaneous one-sided 97.5% bounds for the two primary rates
